info.title: Aether IT API
info.description: Authentication, administration, and project workflow endpoints. JWT access tokens last 48 hours; signed guest project tokens scope guest access to a single project.

tags.name: Employees
tags.description: Employee directory records. Writes require an administrator JWT.

tags.name: Services
tags.description: Service catalog records. Writes require an administrator JWT.

tags.name: Website Content
tags.description: Website content sections. Writes require an administrator JWT.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Create, list, and manage projects. Use a signed-in JWT or the matching guest project token.

tags.name: Conversations & Messages
tags.description: Start project conversations and send or review messages with the AI.

tags.name: AI Analysis
tags.description: Generate and retrieve the structured AI analysis for a project.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Create, list, and securely download private PDF/DOCX exports.

post.description: Public registration always assigns the CUSTOMER role. If guestProjectToken is supplied, links that existing guest project to the new account without changing the project ID.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. On success, returns the user and a JWT access token (201); errors return their HTTP status and an error message.

post.description: Returns a signed JWT accessToken valid for 48 hours. Optionally claims the existing guest project identified by guestProjectToken.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. On success, returns the user and a JWT access token (200); errors return their HTTP status and an error message.

post.description: Requires the account's JWT Bearer token and current password. A successful change invalidates all existing JWTs, including the one used for this request; log in again afterward.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. Success confirms the password change; an invalid JWT or current password returns an error.

post.description: Always returns the same message whether or not the email belongs to an account. Sends a six-digit, single-use verification code by email when eligible; requests are limited to one per account per minute.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. The same message is returned whether or not the email exists; missing SMTP configuration returns HTTP 503 and email delivery failures return a server error.

post.description: Consumes the six-digit, single-use code sent to the email address. Codes expire after 60 minutes and are locked after 5 incorrect attempts. A successful password reset invalidates the account's existing JWT access tokens.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. Success confirms the password change; invalid, expired, or locked codes return an error.

post.description: Requires a valid Bearer JWT. The client must discard the token; stateless access tokens remain valid until they expire.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. Success returns 200 with a success message; errors return their HTTP status and an error message.
One response entry for all outcomes. Success returns the current user; errors return their HTTP status and an error message.

get.description: Admin only. Returns up to 50 users per page.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. Success returns a paginated user list; errors return their HTTP status and an error message.

post.description: Alias of POST /api/auth/signup. Public registration always creates a CUSTOMER.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. On success, returns 201 and a user with a JWT access token; errors return their HTTP status and an error message.

get.description: Available to the account owner or an administrator.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. Success returns the user account; errors return their HTTP status and an error message.

patch.description: Users can update their own profile; use POST /api/auth/change-password to change your own password. Administrators can change other users' passwords and roles. The last administrator cannot be demoted.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. Success returns the updated user; errors return their HTTP status and an error message.

delete.description: Available to the account owner or an administrator. Deletion is blocked while the account owns projects and for the last administrator.

default.description: One response entry for all outcomes. Success returns HTTP 204 with no body; errors return their HTTP status and an error message.
